name: Jan Rigby
story: Jan Rigby is a health geographer with interests in spatial epidemiology, inequality, poverty and women's health. Her GIS background includes a commitment to developing capability for health research in poorer countries. Her publications connect spatial analysis with healthcare access and public-health risk, including research on gambling geography in New Zealand.
Contemporary CDC material identifies Chris Skelly, then Senior Advisor, Health GeoInformatics, and Jan Rigby as organisers of GeoHealth 2002 in Wellington.
